name: Foundational Structure of Simple COMs
statement: For a simple COM $(E,\mathcal L)$, the tope graph is a partial cube and determines the sign-vector system up to coordinate reorientation. Deletions, contractions, and fibers remain COMs, and every face becomes an oriented matroid after deleting its fixed coordinates. The system supports a contractible regular cell complex $\Delta(\mathcal L)$ whose 1-skeleton is the tope graph and whose cells are the oriented-matroid complexes carried by its faces.
comments: The full covector constructions, cell attaching maps, and COM-amalgamation conditions remain in the scholarly source.
